description: Na₅LiFe₂P₂(CO₇)₂ crystallizes in the triclinic P̅1 space group. There are five inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.34-2.72 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.71 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.35-2.87 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.29-2.90 Å. In the fifth Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.86 Å. Li is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Li-O bond distances ranging from 2.15-2.61 Å. There are two inequivalent Fe sites. In the first Fe site, Fe is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted FeO₆ octahedra that share corners with four PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Fe-O bond distances ranging from 2.08-2.38 Å. In the second Fe site, Fe is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted FeO₆ octahedra that share corners with four PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Fe-O bond distances ranging from 2.09-2.36 Å. There are two inequivalent C sites. In the first C site, C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. All C-O bond lengths are 1.30 Å. In the second C site, C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. All C-O bond lengths are 1.30 Å. There are two inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four FeO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 43-61°. There is one shorter (1.55 Å) and three longer (1.56 Å) P-O bond lengths. In the second P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four FeO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 45-57°. There is one shorter (1.54 Å) and three longer (1.56 Å) P-O bond lengths. There are fourteen inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Li, and one C atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four Na and one C atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Fe, and one C atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Li, one Fe, and one C atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to two Na, one Li, one Fe, and one C atom to form distorted corner-sharing ONa₂LiFeC trigonal bipyramids. In the sixth O site, O is bonded to three Na, one Fe, and one C atom to form distorted corner-sharing ONa₃FeC trigonal bipyramids. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Fe, and one P atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Fe, and one P atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Li, one Fe, and one P atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Fe, and one P atom. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded to one Na, one Li, one Fe, and one P atom to form distorted corner-sharing ONaLiFeP tetrahedra. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to one Na, one Li, one Fe, and one P atom. In the thirteenth O site, O is bonded to two Na, one Fe, and one P atom to form distorted corner-sharing ONa₂FeP tetrahedra. In the fourteenth O site, O is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na, one Fe, and one P atom.
